analogy.rationale: IP1 (PTGIR) is a Gs-coupled prostanoid receptor that raises cAMP; prostacyclin receptor agonists should resemble other prostanoid receptor agonists, and since PTGIR is expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines the response should be weak. Other cAMP-linked GPCR classes are only distantly similar.
